notes.title: UI improvements
notes.content:
[b]Improvements done :[/b]
[olist]
[*][b]Improved Visual UI elements [/b]
   [list]
     [*] New Button visuals 
     [*] New quest card visuals
   [/list]
[*][b]Improvements have been made too the "burst" text in-game during events such as :[/b]
   [list]
     [*] Kōmori Rush
     [*] Kōmori Cherry Rush
     [*] Cherry Fruit Burst
   [/list]
[/olist]
[b]Bug Fixes :[/b]
  [olist]
     [*] Fixed bug where pressing "Exit" key while on quest select screen would cause game to 
          crash.
     [*] Fixed bug (removed debug) where picking up negative fruit as last fruit would display 
          "Kōmori Cherry Rush" text.   
   [/olist]
